content.overview: Article 130 provides that the Supreme Court shall sit in Delhi or in such other place or places as the Chief Justice of India may, with the approval of the President, from time to time, appoint.
content.glance: SC sits in Delhi, or at such other place(s) as CJI appoints with President’s approval.
content.study:
Article 130 fixes Delhi as the primary seat and allows the Chief Justice of India, with the approval of the President, to appoint other place or places for sittings.

Examination: Delhi as seat; other places by CJI with President’s approval.
